note: Prayer buffs. One active at a time. Each actor has a prayer-points pool: max points = Prayer level x ticks_per_level (so a full pool runs a 1-point-per-tick buff for level x 50 ticks = 30 s per level). An active buff drains its 'drain' points per tick; at 0 points it ends, and you can't start one with 0 points. Restore: burying bones restores their 'prayer_restore' share of max points (data/items.json) and gives XP; with no buff active the pool also regains 1 point every regen_ticks ticks. Effects: def = enemies' accuracy against you x (1 - v); dmg = your damage x (1 + v); acc = your accuracy x (1 + v); gather = gathering success chance x (1 + v).
